description: BluePages is a deferred compensation planning service and proprietary software from Holcombe Financial, a fee-only advisory firm in Atlanta, GA. It connects high earners to specialist-led strategy for non-qualified deferred compensation (NQDC) and related executive compensation—focused on tax-efficient elections, timing, and payout strategies rather than generic wealth advice. The offering combines document-based analysis (pay stub, tax return, prior elections), AI-assisted tax analysis for deferral and timing scenarios, expert review calls, and a personalized deferral playbook. Founder Rusty Holcombe leads the strategy; the brand emphasizes clarity over jargon and outcomes such as six-figure tax savings through smarter elections (e.g., avoiding lump-sum pitfalls, phased payouts). Holcombe Financial also serves entrepreneurs, corporate executives, and FIRE-minded clients with a broader 'Point of Independence' planning philosophy.
sub_industry: Executive Deferred Compensation & High-Earner Tax Strategy
